title: Woomera range chief's grandfather in secret British UFO investigations

tellings.quote: grandfather was involved in secret investigations with the British government in the late 1950s late 1940s in Britain with the UFOs.

plain: The head of Woomera, a large rocket and weapons testing range in the Australian outback, is said to have a grandfather who took part in secret British government investigations of UFOs in Britain in the late 1940s and 1950s. Ross Coulthart, an Australian investigative journalist, tells Michels this as something he was told, naming Rhys Dalton Morgan in the telling. If true, it would mean Britain was quietly studying UFOs almost as early as anyone.
